faq.title: Questions, answered
faq.q1: Do they need to download an app?
faq.a1: No. It's a link — it opens in any phone browser, including inside Instagram and WhatsApp.
faq.q2: Can I see it before I pay?
faq.a2: Yes — the full gift, free. You only pay when you're ready to send.
faq.q3: Is there really a free option?
faq.a3: Yes. Quick Surprise is free and lives for 24 hours. If they love it, either of you can keep it forever.
faq.a4: You get one link to share. Everyone adds a message, photo or voice note — no sign-up. At the reveal time, it all opens together.
faq.q5: Can I schedule it for midnight?
faq.a5: Yes, in their timezone. We deliver the link by WhatsApp, SMS or email at that exact minute.
faq.a6: Only people with the link. Links are long and unguessable, never indexed by search engines, and you can add a password.
faq.a7: Paste a YouTube or Spotify link and it plays from their official player. We never host music ourselves.
faq.a8: Full refund if it fails to deliver because of us, or within 24 hours if the link was never opened. Write to us — real humans reply.
faq.q9: Can I edit it after sending?
faq.a9: Yes — fix a typo or swap a photo. The link stays the same.

about.title: Why we made {brand}
about.p1: Some things don't fit in a text. A birthday at midnight from 12,000 km away. A sorry that needs more than two words. Twenty friends who all want to say the same thing at once.
about.p2: {brand} turns them into tiny, cinematic worlds that open on any phone. We care about three things: making it feel like a film, making it take two minutes, and keeping it private and honest — no fake discounts, no fake reviews, no dark patterns.
about.p3: The name means 'thread' — the red thread that ties people together, however far apart.
